issues.title: Missing Acceptance Criteria for Core Architecture
issues.why: The root 00-overview.md defines a 'Three-Tier Error Architecture' and 'Universal Response Envelope', but the ACs in 97-acceptance-criteria.md lack specific 'Verifies' clauses for the Tier 2 (Go apperror) and Tier 3 (Frontend Modal) implementation details mentioned in the normative contract.
issues.fix: Add ACs for Tier 2 stack trace serialization and Tier 3 Modal rendering requirements with explicit Verifies clauses.

issues.title: Concurrency and Timeout Edge Cases Unaddressed
issues.why: While retrospectives mention 'Retry/Debounce' fixes, the normative contracts (Phase 50/57) do not define behavior for request timeouts, partial failures in 'Merge' operations, or race conditions in the registry scripts.
issues.fix: Add a 'Resilience' section to the Normative Contract defining timeout limits and partial-failure state transitions.

issues.title: Dangling Sub-module References
issues.why: The overview references '02-go-delegation-fix.md' and '07-logging-and-diagnostics/', but these files are not provided in the context, making it impossible for an offline coder to verify the full logic.
issues.fix: In-line the critical path logic from the missing architecture files into the 00-overview.md or 97-acceptance-criteria.md.
